result:
I shipped two follow-ups, but the screens I re-shot are still at 3, not the 4 the task needs.

**Shipped**
- **v31.59 (cw-pset10):**
  - The rebind callout is now as wide as the pad buttons table (1440).
  - The Settings and Keys scrollbar is 8px.
  - Every Settings row is one 56px height. One row had been 82px because of a hidden hint line.
- **v31.61 (cw-pset11):**
  - The rebind callout uses the raised fill instead of olive.
  - Idle key caps have the quiet `--ui-line` border.
  - The Settings detail strip uses the panel fill.

I changed no wording. Both ships passed their preflight and the gate.

**Critic scores:**

| Screen | Before | After v31.59 | After v31.61 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 75 (pad rebind waiting) | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| 70 (settings, controls) | 2 | 3 | 3 |

The v31.61 pass didn't move either score, so I stopped there. I only re-shot 70, 72, 74 and 75 after the first ship, and 70 and 75 after the second. I never re-shot the others (18, 25–32, 42, 49, 68, 69, 71, 73).

**Why it stalled**
- The critic keeps asking to widen the Settings column and push the steppers to the row edge. That undoes the deliberate 960 column (cw-cardwide, v30.95), where each label sits next to its stepper, so I left it.
- It also contradicts itself between rounds. After I dropped the detail strip fill, it asked for the fill back.

**Not done**
- Snapping the list height to whole 56px rows.
- A 20px tab strip with lb/rb glyphs at the ends.
- "keyboard / pad" group labels in the Settings list.
- Moving "send play data" into the list as a row. Q61 allows moving it, not removing it.
- Any change to the pause box (25, 42, 49). I didn't touch it this run.

The log line is in `notes/ui/changes.md` and the stuck list is in `notes/c-31-ui-pause-settings.md`. Shots are in `notes/shots/c-31y-before`, `c-31y-after` and `c-31y-after2`.

TASK PARTIAL: 70 and 75 are at 3, the other screens were not re-checked, and the pause box and the not-done items above remain.
